segments.title: AI AGENTS MEET GOOGLE WORKSPACE
segments.caption: An easier way to connect AI with everyday tools.
segments.speech: Imagine an AI agent helping you work with Gmail, Google Drive, and Calendar. Google just made that easier!

segments.title: WORKSPACE MCP SERVERS
segments.caption: A standard way for agents to use tools.
segments.speech: Google has announced general availability of Workspace M C P servers. M C P stands for Model Context Protocol.

segments.title: ONE STANDARD. MANY TOOLS.
segments.caption: Gmail • Drive • Calendar • Docs
segments.speech: Instead of building a different integration for every service, developers can connect agents to supported Workspace tools through a standard interface.

segments.title: PERMISSIONS STILL MATTER
segments.caption: Access is controlled, not unlimited.
segments.speech: But this doesn't give an AI unlimited access. The agent still needs the right permissions, and developers must handle access carefully.

segments.title: WE'RE BUILDING AN AI AGENT!
